wholly-owned subsidiary McGraw-Hill Education intends to offer $500M in aggregate principal amount of senior secured notes due 2033 in a private offering.

The Issuer intends to use the net proceeds from the offering, together with borrowings under the A&E term loan facility, to redeem in full the issuer’s outstanding 5.750% secured notes due 2028 and refinance the existing term loan.

title: McGraw Hill proposes $500M senior secured notes offering
